principle: Only source-supported or purely grid-topological adjacency is promoted. Unsupported cross-domain geometry remains unresolved.

MF_ANGULAR.law: Within a fixed layer L, S01..S72 form a cycle C72. NEXT wraps S72->S01; PREV wraps S01->S72.

MF_RADIAL.law: Within a fixed sector S, adjacent sectorized layers connect L01-L02-L03-L04-L05-L06.

MF_CG.law: Each L06 sector connects to the choir/sefirah group whose 8-sector range contains that sector.

MF_CR.law: No one-to-one sector-to-Rose adjacency is promoted because the measured source establishes the Rose domain and 3+7+12 topology but does not freeze an exact sector/petal rotational binding.

CR_INTERNAL.law: T3, H7 and D12 are known cyclic petal/letter families. Their internal cyclic adjacency may be represented independently, but cross-family radial/petal correspondence remains unresolved.

CG_CG.law: CG01..CG09 follow the outer circumference in cyclic order C9.

HC_ANY.law: HC is outside the 463-address registry and receives no graph edges until its scope/sub-addressing gate closes.

major463.warning: The four-component result is intentional evidence of unresolved Rose attachment/cross-family geometry, not permission to invent bridge edges.

compatibility.hnk40: All existing HNK40 paths use MF_ANGULAR/MF_RADIAL only and remain valid under E2.
